name: Piastri vs Lawson - Brazil Turn 1
fia_doc_title: Doc 48 - Offence - Car 81 - Causing a collision
steward_rationale: Car 81 attempted an inside pass at Turn 1 but did not have front axle alongside Car 30's cockpit at the apex. Car 81 locked wheels and caused contact with Car 30.

name: Lawson vs Perez - Las Vegas Turn 14
steward_rationale: Car 30 committed to an inside pass following DRS straight, achieving significant overlap (front axle past Car 11's cockpit) prior to apex. Both cars navigated the chicane with minimal contact.

name: Verstappen vs Norris - Austin Turn 12
fia_doc_title: Doc 69 - Infringement - Car 4 - Leaving track and gaining advantage
steward_rationale: Car 4 attempted an overtake on the outside of Turn 12. Car 1 had front axle ahead at apex and held line rights. Both cars left the track, but Car 4 completed overtake off track and did not return position.

name: Verstappen vs Norris - Mexico Turn 4
fia_doc_title: Doc 29 - Infringement - Car 1 - Forcing Car 4 off track
steward_rationale: Car 4 had significant overlap alongside Car 1 on the outside at corner entry and apex. Car 1 did not give racing room at apex/exit, forcing Car 4 onto grass run-off.

name: Verstappen vs Norris - Mexico Turn 8
fia_doc_title: Doc 30 - Infringement - Car 1 - Leaving track and gaining advantage
steward_rationale: Car 1 lunged down the inside at Turn 8 at excessive speed, carrying both cars off the track and gaining lasting advantage by overtaking Car 4 off circuit.

name: Sainz vs Perez - Baku Straight / Turn 2 Exit
fia_doc_title: Doc 53 - Decision - Car 11 and Car 55 Incident
steward_rationale: Both cars were accelerating side-by-side on the straight after Turn 2. Neither driver made an erratic steering move; lateral convergence caused wheel-to-wheel contact into barrier. Neither driver predominantly to blame.

name: Verstappen vs Norris - Austria Turn 3
fia_doc_title: Doc 65 - Infringement - Car 1 - Causing a collision
steward_rationale: Car 1 moved to the left under braking and turn-in while defending against Car 4 on the outside. Contact occurred between left-rear of Car 1 and right-front of Car 4, causing double punctures.

name: Russell vs Piastri - Montreal Turn 13
fia_doc_title: Doc 55 - Stewards Decision - Turn 13 Chicane Incident
steward_rationale: Car 63 attempted an inside overtake into final chicane, touched wheels with Car 81, and cut across the chicane escape road without retaining position. Deemed hard racing with no lasting advantage.

name: Hamilton vs Colapinto - Las Vegas Turn 1
fia_doc_title: FIA Official Race Record - Lap 15 Lead Change
steward_rationale: Car 44 completed a clean inside overtake into Turn 1 with 75% overlap at apex, full car control, and leaving sufficient racing room on outside.

name: Alonso vs Russell - Melbourne Turn 6
fia_doc_title: Doc 56 - Infringement - Car 14 - Potentially dangerous driving
steward_rationale: Car 14 lifted off throttle and downshifted 100 meters earlier than normal on approach to Turn 6, creating extraordinary closing speed and wake turbulence that contributed to Car 63's crash.

name: Tsunoda vs Albon - Monza Turn 1
fia_doc_title: Doc 38 - Infringement - Car 23 - Causing a collision
steward_rationale: Car 23 attempted an inside pass into Variante del Rettifilo, missed braking point slightly and understeered into the sidepod of Car 22.

name: Magnussen vs Gasly - Monza Turn 4
fia_doc_title: Doc 44 - Infringement - Car 20 - Causing a collision
steward_rationale: Car 20 locked front-right tyre on inside entry of Roggia chicane, understeered into Car 10's left-hand flank, forcing Car 10 wide.

name: Leclerc vs Perez - Las Vegas Turn 14
fia_doc_title: FIA Official Race Record - Lap 50 P2 Pass
steward_rationale: Car 16 executed late braking into Turn 14 chicane down inside, reached apex with 72% overlap, zero wheel lockup, no car contact.

name: Hamilton vs Piastri - Monza Turn 4
fia_doc_title: Doc 45 - Infringement - Car 44 - Causing a collision
steward_rationale: Car 44 attempted an inside pass entering Roggia, cut across to the right too early before completing pass, clipping Car 81's front wing.

name: Sainz vs Piastri - Spa Turn 1
fia_doc_title: Doc 39 - Decision - Turn 1 incident Cars 55 and 81
steward_rationale: First lap incident into tight La Source hairpin. Car 81 squeezed on inside wall while Car 55 locked front axle. Both cars suffered terminal damage in multi-car concertina.

name: Russell vs Verstappen - Baku Turn 2
steward_rationale: Lap 1 side-by-side battle. Car 63 held inside line, suffered slight understeer in dirty air and made side contact with Car 1's sidepod. Treated as Lap 1 racing incident.

name: Hulkenberg vs Alonso - Austria Turn 3
fia_doc_title: Doc 31 - Infringement - Car 27 - Forcing Car 14 off track
steward_rationale: Car 27 made an inside lunge at Turn 3, locked inside front, did not leave a car's width at exit, forcing Car 14 completely off track onto tarmac run-off.

name: Stroll vs Ricciardo - Shanghai Turn 14
fia_doc_title: Doc 42 - Infringement - Car 18 - Causing a collision
steward_rationale: Under Safety Car restart into Turn 14 hairpin, Car 18 failed to anticipate the accordion slowdown of preceding cars and collided directly into the rear of Car 3.
